title: Extraction and reasoning parallel execution with bounded timeouts

test_cases.name: Parallel initiation timing bound
test_cases.input_setup: Launch extraction and diagnosis concurrently through PipelineOrchestrator
test_cases.expected_result: Extraction and diagnosis start within 100 ms of each other
test_cases.evidence: Parallel start verified: tasks initiated within 0.18ms <= 100ms

test_cases.name: Concurrent task scheduling architecture
test_cases.expected_result: asyncio concurrent scheduling with FIRST_COMPLETED progressive streaming
test_cases.evidence: Concurrent non-blocking Task scheduling with FIRST_COMPLETED streaming verified

test_cases.name: Extraction timeout isolation
test_cases.input_setup: Simulate extraction latency exceeding timeout threshold while diagnosis completes
test_cases.expected_result: Extraction timed out; diagnosis output preserved without crash
test_cases.evidence: Extraction timeout gracefully isolated: pipeline continued without hang

test_cases.name: Reasoning timeout isolation
test_cases.input_setup: Simulate diagnosis latency exceeding timeout while extraction completes
test_cases.expected_result: Extraction delivered intact; reasoning timeout handled gracefully
test_cases.evidence: Reasoning timeout gracefully handled: extracted features delivered cleanly

test_cases.name: Dual success parallel merge
test_cases.input_setup: Execute standard parallel pipeline with both extract and diagnose succeeding
test_cases.expected_result: Merged stream encapsulates both extraction and diagnosis events
test_cases.evidence: Both parallel steps succeeded: extraction and diagnosis events streamed
